description:
Hand-written ES module: the RFC 0029 workspace state persistence
        layer (WidgetParamsCodecRegistry, LocalStorageStore,
        captureLiveWorkspace, WorkspaceStatePersister, the
        WorkspaceStatePersistence facade).

        Sits in its own Maven module because it depends on the
        generated codec module (homing-workspace-codecs) — placing it in
        homing-workspace would create a Maven cycle (codec module
        already depends on homing-workspace for the typed records).

        Doctrine — "Generated and Hand-Written Live Apart": hand-written
        side. The JS lives in src/main/resources committed to the repo.
